remarks: Welcome to 101 Eggert Road!  This spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 1,532 square feet of living space and is ready for its next owner. Step through the front door into a bright and inviting double living room, highlighted by a charming arched entryway leading to the formal dining room—perfect for entertaining. The generously sized kitchen features ample cabinet and counter space, along with a comfortable eat-in dining area. The black stove and refrigerator are included with the sale.  The first floor offers exceptional flexibility, featuring two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a bonus room with direct access to the backyard. Upstairs, you'll find an expansive primary suite complete with a private full bathroom and additional attic storage currently utilized as a walk-in closet, offering endless possibilities for customization.  Outside, enjoy a large fenced yard, ideal for pets, gardening, or outdoor gatherings, along with a detached one-car garage.  Conveniently located with easy access to Route 33, this home provides quick connections to all that Western New York has to offer.  Don't miss your opportunity to make this your next home!
